children: Germany Economy Minister Katherina Reiche said real estate expropriation is ruled out in Germany, as the protection of private property is a fundamental principle of the social market economy.
"Fantasies of expropriation and nationalization have no place in Germany," Reiche said.

The far-left leader pushing to take over as mayor of Berlin, Elif Eralp, has pledged to expropriate more than 200,000 housing units from corporate landlords in a campaign that made the party reach their best result in Berlin in last Sunday's election.
